description: This file defines a callback class 'CocoEval' for performing COCO evaluation during training epochs in a TensorFlow/Keras-based object detection pipeline. It imports external modules, notably TensorFlow and a local evaluation utility, and contains methods for initializing the callback and executing evaluation at the end of each epoch.

classes.name: CocoEval
classes.description: A Keras callback class that performs COCO evaluation at the end of each training epoch.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CocoEval callback with a data generator, optional tensorboard logging, and a score threshold.

methods.name: on_epoch_end
methods.description: Executes COCO evaluation at the end of each epoch, updates logs with evaluation metrics, and optionally logs results to TensorBoard.
